rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: The decree forms the Government of the RSFSR, for the period of the radical economic reform, under the direct leadership of the President of the RSFSR; its listed composition begins with the First Deputy Chairman and the Deputy Chairmen and lists no Chairman (point 1). The President heads the Government, conducts its sittings and signs its decisions (point 4); in his absence the First Deputy Chairman conducts sittings and signs resolutions on his instruction (point 2). The decree takes effect from signing (point 12) and is signed 'Президент РСФСР Б. ЕЛЬЦИН', 6 November 1991, N 172.
